summary: Hardened packaged app builds by requiring Python 3.10 and logging packaged app-server startup output for diagnostics.
details: Packaging now requires Python 3.10.6 or newer within the Python 3.10 line to avoid early 3.10 PyInstaller analysis crashes.
The Python server build now fails before PyInstaller when required backend packages are missing from the selected Python 3.10 environment.
Packaged startup now writes Electron main-process logs and shows the startup error with the log path instead of quitting silently.
